limitations: Explicit stations only; unlisted fasteners are not audited.
Flat annular-bearing screws and full open cylindrical bores only; unsupported/ambiguous geometry is unknown.
Engagement is modeled axial overlap. Simplified threads cannot certify thread contact, strength, torque, preload or physical installation.
Bearing support is checked at four radial locations on facing trimmed faces; this is not a pressure/contact-area analysis.
